dataset.source: Windows System.Speech; Microsoft Zira Desktop; en-US synthetic voice reading fictional England property scenarios. Not human or British-accent validation.
normalization: WER normalization removes punctuation and case only; number words are not rewritten to digits.
Clean and noisy clips share one synthetic voice; results are not a population-quality estimate.
